$comment: DTCG 2025.10 and CSS interchange mapping: dtcg.md (Lumen JSON remains canonical).

metrics.description: Optional schema-2 metrics. Each omitted member inherits from the parent theme, then uses the app's metrics. Pack-locked members are forbidden; app-level overrides take precedence.

depth.description: Optional shadow and glow values. Every field inherits independently, then uses the app's depth. Popover opacity in each appearance and radius must be at least menu's; checked by lumen-theme validate. Surface color lift is unchanged.

y.description: Vertical offset in points; must not exceed the resolved radius. Checked by lumen-theme validate.
Vertical offset in points; must not exceed the resolved radius. Checked by lumen-theme validate.
Vertical offset in points; must not exceed the resolved radius. Checked by lumen-theme validate.
Vertical offset in points; must not exceed the resolved radius. Checked by lumen-theme validate.

motion.description: Motion preset. System Reduce Motion remains authoritative.

radiusProfile.description: Corner ramp: standard (4, 6, 8, 10, 12 pt), rounded (6, 8, 10, 12, 12 pt), or one uniform radius. Never exceeds half the smallest 24 pt control height.

typeScale.description: Typography multiplier. Control and row boxes grow above 1; the 24 pt minimum hit target is preserved.

accent.default.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

accent.filled.description: Component role; defaults to menu.highlight. Filled accent shapes: primary buttons, checked boxes, selected chips; deep in dark.

accent.soft.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. A lighter accent for apps' own marks (charts, badges); Lumen's components don't draw it.

accent.subtle.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Accent tint behind text.

activity.background.description: Component role; defaults to bg.inset. The toolbar's activity status capsule.

bg.canvas.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. The main content area.

bg.elevated.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Cards, popovers and raised controls.

bg.hover.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Hovered rows.

bg.hoverRaised.description: Component role; defaults to bg.hover. Hover on cards, popovers, sheets and menus.

bg.inset.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Wells, pills and tags.

bg.insetRaised.description: Component role; defaults to bg.inset. Wells, pills and tags on cards, popovers and sheets.

bg.selected.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Selected rows in the focused window; with the system accent, the canvas tinted with it.

bg.selectedInactive.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Selected rows when the window is inactive.

bg.selectedInactiveRaised.description: Component role; defaults to bg.selectedInactive. Inactive selection on cards, popovers, sheets and menus.

bg.sidebar.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Sidebars and source lists.

bg.window.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Window background and title area.

border.control.description: Component role; defaults to border.strong. Edges of unchecked checkboxes, radios and switches.

border.default.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

border.focus.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

border.strong.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

border.subtle.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

chip.selectedBackground.description: Component role; defaults to accent.filled. The selected filter chip: a filled accent shape, deep in dark.

fg.disabled.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Disabled text; exempt from contrast (WCAG).

fg.link.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

fg.onAccent.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

fg.primary.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

fg.secondary.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

fg.tertiary.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

field.background.description: Component role; defaults to accent.default at 10% over bg.sidebar. Capsule filter and search fields.

hue.blue.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.graphite.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.green.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.indigo.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.orange.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.pink.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.red.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.teal.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.violet.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

hue.yellow.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Categorical hue for tiles and categories.

layoutToggle.on.description: Component role; defaults to accent.default. A panel toggle's region while that panel shows.

menu.highlight.description: Component role; defaults to accent.default. The highlighted item's fill in menus, and the filled selection in pickers and lists; in dark a deep tone under white text.

panel.background.description: Component role; defaults to bg.window. Settings and preference panes.

panel.group.description: Component role; defaults to bg.elevated. Grouped form cards.

sidebar.foreground.description: Component role; defaults to fg.primary. Sidebar text; set it with sidebar.background for a sidebar darker or lighter than the canvas.

sidebar.rowSelectedInactive.description: Component role; defaults to bg.selectedInactive. A selected sidebar row in an inactive window; set it with sidebar.foreground so that text reads on it.

status.danger.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

status.dangerBackground.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Fill behind status.danger text.

status.info.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

status.infoBackground.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Fill behind status.info text.

status.neutral.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

status.neutralBackground.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Fill behind status.neutral text.

status.success.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

status.successBackground.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Fill behind status.success text.

status.warning.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it.

status.warningBackground.description: Semantic role; every complete variant defines it. Fill behind status.warning text.

titlebar.activeBottom.description: Component role; defaults to toolbar.background. Bottom of the title bar's glow while the window is active.

titlebar.activeTop.description: Component role; defaults to toolbar.background. Top of the title bar's glow while the window is active; inactive windows use toolbar.background.

toolbar.secondaryForeground.description: Component role; defaults to fg.secondary. Secondary toolbar text (the identity's location).

welcome.background.description: Component role; defaults to bg.window. The welcome window's hero side, behind the starfield.

welcome.glow.description: Component role; defaults to accent.default. The soft glow behind the app mark.

welcome.panel.description: Component role; defaults to bg.sidebar. The welcome window's recents panel.

highContrast.description: A maximum-legibility theme: components draw their Increase Contrast look for it.
